page: Microsoft Azure D8ads_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadsv7 server family. Powered by an AMD processor with an x86_64 architecture, this instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The virtual machine runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing fast read and write capabilities directly on the host. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach high-performance external disk options. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. No GPU accelerators are present on this hardware profile.

With its 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and integrated local NVMe SSD, the D8ads_v7 is structured for balanced workloads that require a mix of compute power, memory, and fast local temporary storage. The hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for applications such as relational databases, enterprise application hosting, caching layers, and development environments that benefit from dedicated CPU resources and local scratch space without the overhead of specialized GPU hardware.
